name: Speed Demon
description: A wicked entity who leads Duskmourn's possessed racing crew and never leaves Winter's side.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth sends the Speed Demon and Winter to win the Ghirapur Grand Prix and gives Winter Loot.
timeline.quote: He sent the Speed Demon and Winter to win the race and bring the Aetherspark back to Duskmourn.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth chooses Winter as co-captain of Duskmourn's racing team for the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Winter was chosen by Valgavoth as the living representative and co-captain
